title: Copy and Paste Line (yy, p)
instruction_text:
Copy and paste like a pro!

'yy' = yank (copy) the current line
'p'  = paste below the current line

Your task: Duplicate 'Copy this line'

Steps:
1. Move cursor to the 'Copy this line' line
2. Press 'yy' (copies the line)
3. Press 'p' (pastes below)
4. Save and quit with :wq
